manifests.name: MiseOS Git Command Layer
manifests.description: A safe MiseOS command wrapper that maps common Git workflows into operational commands while keeping Git as the execution engine.

changePolicy.major: Human review required for command grammar, destructive behavior, or protected branch policy changes.
changePolicy.minor: Maintainer review required for new command wrappers and safety gates.
changePolicy.patch: Allowed for docs, examples, and non-behavioral fixes after validation.

release.cadence: manual until branch policy integration is stable
release.currentStrategy: Ship as part of @mise-os/cli, with destructive commands blocked unless explicit confirmation flags are provided.
release.nextMilestone: Add branch policy awareness and registry-backed command telemetry.

answers.what: A MiseOS command wrapper for Git.
answers.does: Turns basic and advanced Git commands into MiseOS operating commands with safer defaults and explicit confirmation flags.
answers.permissions: Uses local Git credentials and filesystem access only through Git commands.
answers.registry: Included in @mise-os/cli and documented through registry/git-command-map.json.
answers.changed: Added MiseOS command grammar, safety wrappers, docs, aliases, and CLI delegation for Git workflows.
answers.safe: Safe when used through its default commands; destructive commands require confirmation flags and force push is guarded.
answers.agentExecutable: Agents may run read-only commands automatically; mutating commands require explicit user approval.
